title: Instant Pot Pressure Release Delay
app: Meater probes, Anova Precision Cooker sessions, Instant Pot logs, wine-fridge sensors, ESPHome kitchen sensors, and pantry inventory feeds via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=instantpot:cook
| stats avg(natural_release_min) as avg_release_min, max(natural_release_min) as max_release_min by recipe
| where avg_release_min>20 OR max_release_min>35
| sort - avg_release_min
description: Uses Instant Pot cook logs telemetry to monitor how long recipes spend in natural pressure release in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for programs that keep stretching dinner later than planned, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Instant Pot cook logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how long recipes spend in natural pressure release so you can spot programs that keep stretching dinner later than planned before it becomes annoying.
